rows.note: Use 興奮感 as the all-purpose noun for the intense happy excitement or exhilaration itself.

example.english: Watching the fireworks explode overhead gives me an indescribable exhilaration.
example.traditional: 睇住煙花喺頭頂爆開，真係有種難以形容嘅興奮感。
example.jyutping: tai2 zyu6 jin1 faa1 hai2 tau4 deng2 baau3 hoi1 zan1 hai6 jau5 zung2 naan4 ji5 jing4 jung4 ge3 hing1 fan5 gam2

rows.note: Use 鼓勵 when the noun refers to someone’s act of cheering another person up, rather than the resulting feeling.

example.english: Your encouragement gave me exhilaration and helped me pull myself together.
example.traditional: 你嗰番鼓勵令我重新振作，真係好多謝你。
example.jyutping: nei5 go2 faan1 gu2 lai6 ling6 ngo5 cung4 san1 zan3 zok3 zan1 hai6 hou2 do1 ze6 nei5
